title: Check confidence with output
hook: “I know this” and a checked reconstruction are different evidence.

knows: reading short labels and comparing simple counts
doesNotKnow: Compare felt familiarity with a scored local reconstruction.

objective: Compare felt familiarity with a scored local reconstruction.

claims.text: Scenario, hook and prediction: “I know this” and a checked reconstruction are different evidence. Which provides an observable local check? Correct option: Checked reconstruction. All fixture labels, example words, dates, task durations and file fields are stipulated exercise data.

claims.text: The check counts matching positions. It can expose a mismatch, but this single attempt cannot estimate future retention or general ability.

recall.question: You feel sure you know a four-step route. Which gives you evidence you can check?
options: Write the steps, then compare with notes
Rate your confidence out of ten
Skim it to see if it feels familiar
recall.why: A written attempt can be compared step by step; a feeling of familiarity cannot be checked against anything.
